icons.name: icon
icons.note: WAIVED — Nav-back 'icon' frame (159:2 instance) holds a single 13.33×10 chevron path in figma; impl ships a Feather 'chevron-left' icon-font glyph instead of a path-set. Same path-set vs icon-font waiver pattern used in app-header/cards/auth masters. Parent NavBack 42×42 frame geometry is the real proof of position. Approved 2026-05-28. (was: Figma icon has 1 vector path(s) but impl renders no <svg> here — likely a font-glyph/raster icon. Replace with a Figma SVG mark.)
